assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic website hero photograph for a fictional Halloween roadside attraction called Bone Appétit, an old haunted pizzeria with a pumpkin trail. Primary request: exceptionally atmospheric wide cinematic exterior scene of a rambling old Victorian roadside pizzeria at blue hour in late autumn, warm amber windows and a red-orange vintage neon PIZZA sign, glowing carved jack-o-lanterns in foreground, old crooked wooden fence, cozy porch and mismatched chairs, bare branches silhouetted above, faint mist along ground, deep near-black evergreen forest behind. A little eccentric, handcrafted Americana Halloween tourist trap, charming and inviting with just enough eerie mystery, practical movie set not a cartoon, fine 35mm film grain. Composition: very wide landscape 3:2, the Victorian house and readable glowing PIZZA sign concentrated in the right half, left third mostly dark wooded negative space for website title overlay. Warm orange light contrasts with muted olive and charcoal night, realistic wood and falling leaves, glowing pumpkin faces in bottom right. No people, no gore, no watermark, no overlaid captions, no other text except PIZZA. Rich photographic detail, intentional art direction, sophisticated analog cinema look.

Twilight, muted dark olive foliage, cinnamon brown and burnt orange, warm amber practical lights. A real artisanal Halloween attraction, cozy spooky, enchanting Americana, analog movie-set photography, natural texture, light film grain, inviting enough to want to walk inside. No people, no text, no logos, no gore, no buildings.
